thresholdClassification.unknown: Missing/invalid values retained and counted as unknown; never changed to zero.
thresholdClassification.notTested: No RSI(14) in telemetry; no body>=3 because body is percentage of candle range and PLM scanner timeframe/gate is not stamped; no 2D composite without pre-defined contract.

metricNotes.percentiles: Implementation ranks up to latest 1,440 valid observations: 15m≈15d, 30m≈30d, 1h≈60d; 4h is capped by available 60d history—not uniform 60d.
metricNotes.atrChange3: Raw absolute price-unit ATR difference over three bars; no cross-symbol normalization.
metricNotes.bollingerExpansion3: Absolute bandwidth change over three bars; descriptive.
metricNotes.candleTelemetry: Direction, closeLocation, body%, upper/lower wicks%, rangeATR and patterns stored; no explicit burst field.
